text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I hear a familiar voice from the park while out on a walk…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's why… you know! Is this a… place for…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: …And, like… such a pain! I want you to… just like…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory and Daitaku Helios are arguing about something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can guess what kind of issue a disciplinary committee member and a party lover might be arguing about.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Even if we don't have classes, this kind of behavior is unacceptable!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: C'moooon! It's a day off! Let it slide, just this once! ☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not! In fact, you need to write an essay explaining yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I imagine it's something like that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ugh! We're going to do this just like we planned!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahey hey! ☆ Bet! ♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Helios said she found a lost dog!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I saw it when I was running! The poor pupper looked so lost and sad! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I bet the owner is legit losing their mind right now.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So we like, gotta help it out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We already came up with a plan to find the owner!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm going to try shouting for them in case they're still nearby.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And I'm gonna post on Umastagram to get this on everyone's feed! Waheeeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahey! ♪

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for the trouble! Thank you so much for finding him!

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No more running off on your own, now, you hear?!
choice_data_list: You two make a great team.
You two make a great team.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Anyone would want to help out if they found a dog in distress!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right?! But y'know, there's a reason why we're besties now.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Actually, Helios and I run together all the time!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Yeah! It's actually, like, low-key magical. I think we've run together, like, eight times already this month!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes! We don't plan it or anything, but we're always at the same place at the same time. It's almost like destiny is bringing us together!
choice_data_list: Well, I hope you two keep at it.
Well, I hope you two keep at it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes! We don't plan it or anything, but we're always at the same place at the same time. It's almost like destiny is bringing us together!
choice_data_list: Well, I hope you two keep at it.
Well, I hope you two keep at it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: There's zero chance I give up on my bestie!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Anyway, why don't we go for a run since we're here and all?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahey! Now you're talking!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the two of them enjoy a friendly run.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Psychic?! Do you really think so?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For real?! That goes sooo hard! ☆ Do you really think we have superpowers?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If so, I want to use this power for good!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wanna be superhero besties?! It'll be awesome! We'll be auramaxxing like there's no tomorrow! ☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hold on! If we're gonna be superheroes, we've got to hide our identities! We're gonna need costumes too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing the two of them get so excited, I can't bring myself to tell them I was only joking.
